description.ja: 「機動戦士Ｚガンダム」に登場するライバルＭＳ「キュベレイ」をＭＧシリーズで遂にプラモデル化。流線型の美しいフォルムを余すところなく再現。
description.en: The rival MS "Qubeley " that appears in " Mobile Suit Z Gundam" has finally been made into a plastic model in the MG series. The beautiful streamlined form has been thoroughly reproduced.

description.ja: 武器に、ビームサーベル、ファンネルが付属。
description.en: Beam saber and funnel are included as weapons.

description.ja: 飛行形態にも変形可能です。
description.en: Can also be transformed into flight form.
